name: hstar_bench
description: hstar_bench is a benchmark suite hosted on Hugging Face targeting embodied/robotic tasks in simulated humanoid environments. It measures agent performance on control, manipulation, and task-completion scenarios using multi-sensory observations. The benchmark is intended to evaluate robustness and generalization of policies across episodes and tasks.
reputation: A niche robotics benchmark with modest adoption among simulation and humanoid-control researchers on Hugging Face.
